mapper.sql: wm.id, wm.sender_user_id, u.name AS sender_name, u.profile_image_filename AS sender_profile_image_filename, wm.title, wm.body, wm.importance, wm.sent_at, wm.created_at, wm.updated_at

sql.if: AND (wm.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR wm.body LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_memos (sender_user_id, title, body, importance, sent_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{senderUserId}, #{title}, #{body}, #{importance}, #{sentAt}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO work_memo_recipients (memo_id, recipient_user_id, read_at, is_starred, created_at) VALUES (#{memoId}, #{recipientUserId}, #{readAt}, #{starred}, NOW())

INSERT INTO work_memo_attachments (memo_id, original_filename, stored_filename, content_type, file_size, attachment_type, created_at) VALUES (#{memoId}, #{originalFilename}, #{storedFilename}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{attachmentType}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT , r.read_at AS read_at, r.is_starred AS starred FROM work_memos wm JOIN work_memo_recipients r ON r.memo_id = wm.id AND r.recipient_user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = wm.sender_user_id WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY wm.sent_at DESC, wm.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_memo_recipients r1 WHERE r1.memo_id = wm.id) AS recipient_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_memo_recipients r2 WHERE r2.memo_id = wm.id AND r2.read_at IS NULL) AS unread_recipient_count FROM work_memos wm LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = wm.sender_user_id WHERE wm.sender_user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY wm.sent_at DESC, wm.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT , r.read_at AS read_at, r.is_starred AS starred FROM work_memos wm JOIN work_memo_recipients r ON r.memo_id = wm.id AND r.recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_starred = TRUE LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = wm.sender_user_id WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY wm.sent_at DESC, wm.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_memos wm JOIN work_memo_recipients r ON r.memo_id = wm.id AND r.recipient_user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = wm.sender_user_id WHERE 1=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_memos wm LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = wm.sender_user_id WHERE wm.sender_user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_memos wm JOIN work_memo_recipients r ON r.memo_id = wm.id AND r.recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_starred = TRUE LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = wm.sender_user_id WHERE 1=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_memo_recipients r WHERE r.recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND r.read_at IS NULL

SELECT , r.read_at AS read_at, r.is_starred AS starred, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work_memo_recipients r1 WHERE r1.memo_id = wm.id) AS recipient_count FROM work_memos wm LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = wm.sender_user_id LEFT JOIN work_memo_recipients r ON r.memo_id = wm.id AND r.recipient_user_id = #{userId} WHERE wm.id = #{memoId} AND (wm.sender_user_id = #{userId} OR r.id IS NOT NULL)

SELECT r.id, r.memo_id, r.recipient_user_id, u.name AS recipient_name, r.read_at, r.is_starred AS starred, r.created_at FROM work_memo_recipients r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.recipient_user_id WHERE r.memo_id = #{memoId} ORDER BY u.name
SELECT id, memo_id, original_filename, stored_filename, content_type, file_size, attachment_type, created_at FROM work_memo_attachments WHERE memo_id = #{memoId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE work_memo_recipients SET read_at = NOW() WHERE memo_id = #{memoId} AND recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
